metas.name: The Last Dance
metas.description: A 10-part documentary chronicling the untold story of Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls dynasty with rare, never-before-seen footage and sound from the 1997-98 championship season – plus over 100 interviews with famous figures and basketball’s biggest names.

metas.name: 30 for 30
metas.description: 30 for 30 is the title for a series of documentary films airing on ESPN, its sister networks, and online highlighting interesting people and events in sports history. This currently includes four "volumes" of 30 episodes each, a 13-episode series under the ESPN Films Presents title in 2011–2012, and a series of 30 for 30 Shorts shown through the ESPN.com website. The series has also expanded to include Soccer Stories, which aired in advance of the 2014 FIFA World Cup, and audio podcasts.  This entry refers to the main Volumes of the series presented by ESPN

metas.name: The Test
metas.description: A docuseries following the Australian Men’s Cricket Team, offering a behind-the-scenes look at how one of the world’s best cricket teams fell from grace and was forced to reclaim their title and integrity.

metas.name: Bandon Mein Tha Dum!
metas.description: Witness the greatest fightback for the Border-Gavaskar Trophy. The story of Men in Blue who led India's biggest triumph in Test history. The four-part series encapsulates the tension, the excitement of thrilling games, behind-the-scenes footage and candid narratives from the cricketers, coaches, and journalists involved.

metas.name: Undertaker: The Last Ride
metas.description: The anticipated WWE Network docuseries will look back on The Undertaker’s storied WWE career and place a focus on the ongoing challenges the wrestling legend appears to have with a career beginning to near it's end.

metas.name: The Other Sport
metas.description: The Other Sport (Swedish: Den andra sporten) is a three-part documentary series zooming in on the often harsh conditions of women's football/soccer in Sweden since the first clubs got structurally organized in the mid-1960's up until this very day.

metas.name: Earnhardt
metas.description: The untold story of Dale Earnhardt Sr.'s ascent as NASCAR's preeminent figure. His charm resonated beyond the sport, yielding fame and fortune. An intimate exploration of a working-class icon's impact on his family and the racing world.

metas.name: Real Madrid: Until the End
metas.description: Step onto the field and go behind the scenes with the iconic soccer team for a look at their astonishing 2021–2022 season. Fueled by their fervent fans, they defy the odds and silence the skeptics.

1999 was a year of groundbreaking success for England’s biggest and most powerful football club, Manchester United. Despite dominating domestic football during the 90s, manager Alex Ferguson was yet to restore Manchester United’s European glory when in 1999, glory arrived in an unprecedented fashion.

metas.name: Muhammad Ali
metas.description: Muhammad Ali brings to life the iconic heavyweight boxing champion who became an inspiration to people everywhere.

metas.name: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
metas.description: Drivers, managers and team owners live life in the fast lane — both on and off the track — during each cutthroat season of Formula 1 racing.

metas.name: Rafa
metas.description: RAFA retraces Nadal's remarkable journey with cinematic scope, combining testimonies from those who know him best—on and off the court—with unseen moments that reveal what lies behind the legend.

metas.name: All or Nothing
metas.description: For the first time in history, Amazon and NFL Films present an unprecedented inside look at the lives of players, coaches and owners of a franchise over the course of an entire NFL season. Witness the real life, behind the scenes journey on the field, off the field, and everything in between.

metas.name: Man in the Arena: Tom Brady
metas.description: Tom Brady shares a personal account of his 10 Super Bowl appearances, deconstructing the milestones of his career by exploring each victory and defeat.

metas.name: Last Chance U
metas.description: In a docuseries set at one of NCAA football's most fertile recruiting grounds, guys with red flags seek to prove their worth on the field and in class.

metas.name: Brawn: The Impossible Formula 1 Story
metas.description: Keanu Reeves tells one of the greatest sagas in Formula 1 history. Through the insights of Ross Brawn and revered racing icons like Jenson Button and Rubens Barrichello, all is revealed in this gripping four-part series. From the formation of Brawn GP see their remarkable journey through strategic manoeuvres and financial trials during an exceptionally competitive era in the annals of the sport.

metas.name: What's My Name | Muhammad Ali
metas.description: Explore Ali’s challenges, confrontations, comebacks and triumphs through recordings of his own voice. The two-part documentary paints an intimate portrait of a man who was a beacon of hope for oppressed people around the world and, in his later years, was recognized as a global citizen and a symbol of humanity and understanding.

metas.name: Welcome to Wrexham
metas.description: Documentary series tracking the dreams and worries of Wrexham, a working-class town in North Wales, UK, as two Hollywood stars (Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds) take ownership of the town’s historic yet struggling football club.

metas.name: Last Chance U: Basketball
metas.description: Hit the hardwood in East Los Angeles as a coach with strong convictions leads young men who hope to fulfill major college potential.

metas.name: The Dynasty: New England Patriots
metas.description: Go inside the franchise's 20-year journey, from the unique chemistry that fueled six Super Bowl wins to the internal strife that sparked a turf war. Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft, and key players reveal the road to—and cost of—greatness.

metas.name: Celtics City
metas.description: Containing extensive, never-before-seen archives and more than 80 interviews of past and present Boston Celtics legends, this series chronicles the history, cultural impact, and extraordinary tale of the NBA's winningest and most storied franchise, the Boston Celtics,

metas.name: FaceOff: Inside the NHL
metas.description: This series gives unprecedented access to the National Hockey League's biggest teams and most compelling players, all at different stages of their careers, as they embark throughout the season on the ultimate pursuit of glory – winning the coveted Stanley Cup.

metas.name: Doubters to Believers Liverpool FC: Klopp's Era
metas.description: Midway through the 2023/24 season, Jürgen Klopp stuns Liverpool fans by announcing his departure. This series charts his final season and nine year tenure, showing how he turned doubters into believers and led the club to glory.

metas.name: Lucky!
metas.description: The extraordinary story of Bernie Ecclestone's meteoric rise from post-war car dealer to the creation and 50-year reign over the cutthroat world of Formula One.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Arsenal
metas.description: Follow the iconic football club during an unforgettable season. As fans return to stadiums, the 2021-22 football season puts pressure on Arsenal's manager Mikel Arteta and his young team to get back to their former glories and back into Europe. Offering unprecedented access and capturing the highs and lows of life on and off the pitch, this is football at its finest: raw, dramatic and full of passion.

metas.name: America's Team: The Gambler and His Cowboys
metas.description: Team owner Jerry Jones' journey transforming the Cowboys. Leading players/coaches to 3 NFL titles in '90s, becoming innovative sports leader with world's most valuable franchise.

metas.name: The Comeback: 2004 Boston Red Sox
metas.description: This definitive docuseries chronicles the Red Sox's journey to their first World Series title in 86 years via interviews with star players and personnel.

metas.name: Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend
metas.description: Follow the legend's epic journey through five World Cups, culminating in 2022's triumph. As the championship run unfolds, Messi shares some of his most personal reflections—on his national team career and the challenges he's faced.

metas.name: Beckham
metas.description: With never-before-seen footage, this docuseries follows David Beckham's meteoric rise from humble beginnings to global football stardom.

metas.name: Sunderland 'Til I Die
metas.description: This docuseries follows English soccer club Sunderland through the 2017-18 season as they try to bounce back after relegation from the Premier League.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Manchester City
metas.description: Legendary coach Pep Guardiola leads his Manchester City team through the 2017-18 football season.

metas.name: Tour de France: Unchained
metas.description: Through tears and triumph, this series follows several cycling teams as they compete in the 2022 installment of the world's most grueling bike race.

metas.name: 100 Foot Wave
metas.description: The decade-long odyssey of surfing pioneer Garrett McNamara, who, after visiting Nazaré, Portugal in hopes of conquering a 100-foot wave, pushed the sport to ever-greater heights and alongside locals helped transform the small fishing village into the world’s preeminent big-wave surfing destination.

metas.name: Wrestlers
metas.description: At a storied professional wrestling organization, new owners and a roster of rising stars strive to make an impact beyond the ring in this docuseries.

metas.name: FC Bayern - Behind the Legend
metas.description: For the first time in their history, FC Bayern Munich gives us unfettered access to the locker room and behind the scenes at this top club. The 6-part documentary covers the turbulent season after their Champions League triumph in Lisbon, celebrates the legendary victories from the past, and links momentous events in Bayern's history to the current team.

metas.name: Cheer
metas.description: The stakes on the mat are high, but for these cheerleaders, the only thing more brutal than their workouts and more exceptional than their performances are the stories of adversity and triumph behind the athletes themselves.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Tottenham Hotspur
metas.description: A fly-on-the-wall inside look at the goings-on of Tottenham Hotspur during the 2019-20 football season.

metas.name: Quarterback
metas.description: Follow the bruised bodies, soul-crushing fumbles, agonizing losses, and pure joy of three NFL quarterbacks during one season.

metas.name: Take Us Home: Leeds United
metas.description: English football's famous 'fallen giant' Leeds United is at the start of a journey: to win promotion back to the Premier League. New owner Andrea Radrizzani has recruited a world-class head coach, Marcelo Bielsa, to lead the team back to the promised land. This will be one of the most dramatic seasons in the club's history as fans, players and a city start to dream of a return to the top flight.

metas.name: All or Nothing: New Zealand All Blacks
metas.description: For the first time ever, The New Zealand All Blacks rugby team, known as the winningest team in global sports history, allows cameras into their super secretive world to witness one of their most difficult seasons yet. Over four months, they face the demands of the most physically gruelling team sport on the planet to uphold a legacy of excellence and dominance that goes back well over a century.

metas.name: Full Swing
metas.description: This immersive documentary series follows a diverse group of professional golfers - on and off the course - during a relentless season of competition.

metas.name: Matchday: Inside FC Barcelona
metas.description: Inside FC Barcelona, which follows the famed soccer club through its 2018-2019 season.

metas.name: This Is Football
metas.description: An emotionally-charged, six-part documentary, exploring football's extraordinary impact on the world. From the streets of Delhi to the fields of post-war Rwanda to the pitches of the Champions League, this globe-spanning series tells a unique story of the game and its power to unite countries, inspire generations and captivate billions.

metas.name: Tiger
metas.description: A revealing look at the rise, fall, and epic comeback of global icon Tiger Woods. The series paints an intimate picture of the prodigy whose dedication and obsession with the game of golf not only took his fame and success to new heights, but also down a dark, spiraling road that eventually led to a legendary sports comeback, culminated by his victory at the 2019 Masters.

metas.name: Bill Russell: Legend
metas.description: Winningest NBA champion and civil rights icon Bill Russell builds a larger-than-life legacy on and off the court in this biographical documentary.

metas.name: Ángel Di María: Breaking Down the Wall
metas.description: From his humble origins to becoming champion of the world, this documentary series recounts the life and career of the iconic Argentinian soccer player.

metas.name: MOURINHO
metas.description: This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.

metas.name: Receiver
metas.description: This riveting sports series follows the 2023 season of NFL receivers Davante Adams, Justin Jefferson, George Kittle, Deebo Samuel and Amon-Ra St. Brown.

metas.name: Shaq
metas.description: Featuring a series of revealing interviews with Shaquille O'Neal, this four-part documentary tells the story of a basketball legend unlike any other, whose larger-than-life personality transcended the sport and transformed him into a cultural icon.

metas.name: They Call Me Magic
metas.description: Earvin “Magic” Johnson is an icon for the ages—from humble beginnings to the Dream Team to business titan. Featuring interviews with President Obama, Larry Bird, Pat Riley, and more, this docuseries charts the life and career of a legend.

metas.name: QB1: Beyond the Lights
metas.description: A 10-part docuseries following high-school quarterbacks, on and off the field, throughout their unforgettable senior seasons.

metas.name: A Beautiful Obsession
metas.description: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

metas.name: Court of Gold
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with the top medal contenders in men's basketball as they battle for gold and glory at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

metas.name: Losers
metas.description: In a "winning is everything" society, how do we handle failure? This series profiles athletes who have turned the agony of defeat into human triumph.

metas.name: All or Nothing: The Michigan Wolverines
metas.description: All or Nothing: The Michigan Wolverines goes behind-the-scenes of the winningest program in college football to chronicle Michigan's 2017 season. Head coach Jim Harbaugh leads his alma mater's young team as the series provides an intimate look at the lives, both on the field and off, of the student athletes charged with carrying on Michigan's legacy.

metas.name: Real Madrid: The White Legend
metas.description: Real Madrid is the centenarian club that has produced a winning team in every era and generation. No other club has matched the success of the eternal champion. It is a role model for the sporting world. The club’s players and admirers take a look back at the milestones and historic adversity that have made Real Madrid the best team in the world.

metas.name: Lance
metas.description: This documentary chronicles Lance Armstrong's cycling triumphs, his cancer diagnosis, and the controversy that upended his career.

metas.name: Super League: The War for Football
metas.description: The past, present, and future of European football collide when plans for a breakaway league emerge, leaving the game’s most powerful leaders to defend—or upend—the traditions of the sport.

metas.name: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose
metas.description: A retrospective journey, spanning more than 60 years, to tell the story of Pete Rose, baseball's all-time hits leader whose on-field achievements and off-field transgressions have made him one of the most polarizing figures in all of sports.

metas.name: FC Barcelona: A New Era
metas.description: Futbol Club Barcelona has enjoyed the best football of the world throughout its history. However, these past few years haven’t lived up to the club’s reputation. After having won every title as a captain, Xavi Hernández is chosen to manage the new project and recover the style and success of the old days.

metas.name: Fernando
metas.description: The documentary series shows Alonso's passion for competing at the highest level and his determination to win. Documented last year, from his presence on the most important circuits, like the Indianapolis 500 or the 24 hours of Le Mans, until his climax with his debut on the Dakar last January, Fernando offers access in his life.

metas.name: The Playbook
metas.description: Coaches with championship résumés share their personal rules for success in sports and life in this reflective and inspiring documentary series.

metas.name: SPRINT
metas.description: Elite sprinters navigate training, media scrutiny and fierce competition in this sports series following their race to become the world's fastest humans.

metas.name: The Least Expected Day: Inside the Movistar Team 2019
metas.description: Pro cycling’s Movistar Team sets their sights on victory while on the road as they face challenges, controversy and internal conflict.

metas.name: Boom! Boom! The World vs Boris Becker
metas.description: An inside look at the controversial life and career of tennis great Boris Becker—featuring interviews with John McEnroe, Novak Djokovic, Björn Borg, and other icons.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Toronto Maple Leafs
metas.description: The first of the All or Nothing franchise to follow an NHL team, the docu-series brings fans closer to the Toronto Maple Leafs organization than ever before, with cameras capturing every moment during the 104th NHL regular season and playoffs.

metas.name: Break Point
metas.description: Travel alongside some of the world's most talented tennis players as they swing for greatness and Grand Slams through an action-packed season.

metas.name: Uninterrupted's Top Class
metas.description: Follow a new mecca of high school athletics nestled just outside of Los Angeles, the back-to-back state champion Sierra Canyon Trailblazers. Viewers get exclusive access to the team as they balance the pressures of competing on a global stage while finding success at one of the most academically elite high schools in the country.

metas.name: Bad Sport
metas.description: True crime and sports come together in this docuseries. Global controversies and scandals are explored through reports from those involved.

metas.name: Simone Biles Rising
metas.description: Follow gymnast Simone Biles as she balances her personal life, mental health journey and training ahead of a highly anticipated return to the Olympics Games of Paris 2024.

metas.name: The Golden Boy
metas.description: Nicknamed "The Golden Boy," Oscar De La Hoya – with his good looks, electric charisma, and heartfelt story of winning Olympic gold for his dying mother – rocketed to national prominence as a superstar both in and outside the ring. But all was not what it appeared to be behind that polished facade.

metas.name: Together: Treble Winners
metas.description: This docuseries relives the record-breaking 2022-23 season for Manchester City FC, which saw the Blues achieving an unprecedented treble win.

metas.name: Basketball or Nothing
metas.description: Follow the lives of the Chinle High basketball team in Arizona's Navajo Nation on a quest to win a state championship and bring pride to their isolated community.

metas.name: Edge of the Earth
metas.description: Follow four groups of elite action-adventure athletes on four unique, never-before-accomplished missions taking place around the globe, within awe-inspiring, undiscovered realms of nature.

metas.name: Starting 5
metas.description: Follows 5 NBA players throughout an entire NBA series, delving into their on-court performance and off-court personal lives.

metas.name: First Team: Juventus
metas.description: Follow renowned soccer club Juventus on and off the pitch as they attempt to win a seventh straight Italian title and achieve Champions League glory.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Juventus
metas.description: Burning defeats and victorious triumphs, All or Nothing follows Juventus, one of the world’s greatest clubs, through a memorable season of change. Unprecedented and exclusive access to Cristiano Ronaldo and to some of the greatest names of world football, dramatic moments behind the scenes, an unmissable series about a championship that will keep you on your toes until the very last day.

metas.name: Maradona in Mexico
metas.description: The Dorados, Culiacan's local team, are at the bottom of the rankings when Maradona arrives, looking for a fresh start. The experts predict disaster.

metas.name: Le Mans: Racing Is Everything
metas.description: The 24 Hours of Le Mans is a motor race like no other. Taking place in France each year, it is an endurance test for drivers and cars that literally takes 24 hours to complete. Traveling from Kuala Lumpur to the Côte D’Azur, shot in breathtaking 4K and with unprecedented access to six of the teams competing for glory, Le Mans: Racing Is Everything is motorsport as you’ve never seen it before.

metas.name: SEC Football: Any Given Saturday
metas.description: Follow college football's most elite players and coaches in this unfiltered documentary series that goes behind the scenes of a dramatic SEC season.

metas.name: McGREGOR FOREVER
metas.description: Conor McGregor's brutal strikes and trash-talking swagger made him the UFC's biggest draw. This rousing documentary series follows his dynamic career.

metas.name: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
metas.description: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

metas.name: We Are Newcastle United
metas.description: Having spent over £300 million to buy the club, appointed a new Head Coach, Eddie Howe, and made a bold statement of intent by signing several big name players, fans' expectations are rocketing and the new owners and Head Coach have much to do to transform the club's fortunes. This series follows life at the club both on and off the pitch.

metas.name: All or Nothing: Brazil National Team
metas.description: The series follows the newly crowned champions of the 2019 Copa América tournament, the Brazilian football team, in a behind-the-scenes multi-part exclusive.
